title: 企业入驻与服务说明
body:
中企展馆由河北企元数智科技有限公司运营，为中小微企业提供企业信息、产品资料、行业分类及区域查询、展厅网址和二维码分享、联系方式展示及展厅管理服务。官方网站：zqzhg.com；Android应用名称：大陆农机，应用内农业机械厅名称：中企展馆-农业机械厅。
一、基础入驻永久免费
企业可免费注册和维护标准企业展厅，免费发布及更新企业介绍、产品图片、参数与联系方式，免费使用标准模板、平台内专属网址和宣传二维码。基础入驻、标准展厅和基础服务不收取年费。
二、基础存储资源
默认免费额度为200 MB（200,000,000字节），企业独立调整额度及实际使用量以企业后台为准。已用容量包括原文件及由平台保存的缩略图、水印等衍生文件；上传中的资源会预占容量。平台公开文件类型、大小和容量限制。达到90%时提醒优化，额度不足时暂停新上传，可通过服务申请联系管理员；不自动收费、不因超额删除已有合法资料。目前不提供付费扩容。
三、公平开放的展示机会
首页最多展示12家企业，推荐资格经管理员审核后进入免费轮换池，北京时间每日零点轮换。优先安排未展示或最久未展示的企业，同等情况下兼顾主营分类、地区及已审核资料完整度。企业介绍、标识或封面、产品图片及参数用于完整度评价。名额不足时按实际数量展示；不提供竞价、付费排名或商业固定位置。未进入首页的企业仍可通过分类、区域和搜索访问。
四、标准模板与稳定网址
一企一展厅、一企一网址、一企一码。企业可以长期更新资料，正常更新不改变网址或二维码。平台正常运营、企业依法依约使用的前提下保持访问地址稳定；平台升级确需调整路径时尽可能保留历史跳转，并通过工作台通知。当前不提供收费定制建站。
五、企业资料与内容审核
企业、产品及媒体资料由平台按现有内容审核流程处理，不再单独提交企业身份核验，不收集法定代表人、经办人、营业执照或经办授权证明。企业保证填写资料真实、合法且有权使用，发布前主动确认当前协议；审核通过后公开，修改审核期间继续展示已发布版本。
六、资料权属及合法权益
企业保证资料真实、合法并拥有使用权；平台不因提供免费服务取得企业上传资料的所有权。平台在提供服务和履行法定义务所必需的范围内处理资料。企业可通过服务申请提出资料导出、停止展示或退出申请，平台核验归属后处理，依法应保留的记录另行说明。违法或侵权内容可被限制、下架并保留处置记录。
七、当前服务边界
当前版本仅提供免费展示与信息查询，不提供在线订单、支付、结算、竞价排名、采购需求发布、询报价、洽谈或交易撮合。企业通过公开电话或微信自行联系，平台不参与资金收付。后续扩展服务须另行履行相应手续并公布规则，不因免费而推定无需其他许可。
八、受理与适用
通过网站页脚、企业工作台或App设置的“投诉与服务申请”提交工单并凭查询凭证查看反馈。具体权利义务以已发布的企业展厅服务协议、用户协议及隐私政策为准。
body_en:
Operated by Hebei Qiyuan Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd., ZQZG provides company and product information, industry and regional search, stable showroom links, QR sharing and contact information. Website: zqzhg.com. Android identity: 大陆农机; agricultural hall: 中企展馆-农业机械厅.
1. Permanently free basic admission
Company registration, standard showrooms, profile and product updates, standard templates, platform showroom URLs and QR codes are free. No basic admission, standard showroom or basic annual service fees are charged.
2. Free storage
The default allowance is 200 MB (200,000,000 bytes). Your workspace shows any individual allowance. Usage includes originals and stored thumbnails and watermark derivatives; uploads reserve capacity. At 90% we show a warning. Insufficient allowance blocks new uploads, without automatic charges or deletion of existing lawful materials. Contact an administrator through a service request for optimization or a free adjustment. Paid expansion is unavailable.
3. Free rotation
Up to 12 reviewed companies appear daily. Administrators approve eligibility. Rotation changes at midnight China time, prioritizing never or least recently displayed companies, with industry, region and completeness considered for ties. Reviewed descriptions, branding, product images and parameters determine completeness. Fewer eligible companies means fewer cards. No bidding, paid ranking or commercial fixed slots. All public companies remain searchable.
4. Standard template and stable links
Each company has one showroom with a stable URL and QR code. Normal updates do not change the address. Stability applies while the platform operates and the company uses it lawfully. Necessary path changes retain redirects where possible and are announced in the workspace. Paid custom development is unavailable.
5. Verification and review
Company, product and media materials follow the existing content review process. There is no separate company identity submission. Legal representative names, agent names, business licences and agent authorization documents are not collected. Companies must provide truthful, lawful materials they are authorized to use, actively accept current agreements and obtain content approval before publication. Previously published versions remain visible during review.
6. Rights and ownership
Companies must own or be authorized to use lawful and accurate materials. Free service does not transfer ownership to the platform. Processing is limited to service and legal needs. Request export, unpublishing or withdrawal through service requests; ownership is verified and any legally retained records are explained. Unlawful or infringing content may be restricted with an audit record.
7. Current service boundaries
This release provides free display and information search, without orders, payments, settlement, bidding, procurement publication, inquiries, quotations, negotiations or transaction matching. Companies can contact each other by public phone or WeChat. The platform does not handle transaction funds. Future services require separate procedures and rules. Free operation does not establish a licensing exemption.
8. Assistance
Use Complaints and service requests on the website or in app settings. Keep the private lookup credential to read replies. Published agreements and the privacy policy define the detailed terms.

title: 企业展厅服务协议
body:
服务提供方：河北企元数智科技有限公司；服务接受方：主动确认本协议的入驻企业及其获授权经办人。
一、服务内容及费用
基础入驻、标准企业展厅、平台内专属网址、二维码、资料长期维护及规定额度内基础存储永久免费，不收取基础服务年费。默认免费存储200 MB，企业后台公布个别调整额度。平台当前不提供收费扩容、竞价推广、收费定制或在线支付。
二、企业义务与发布
企业、产品及媒体资料由平台按现有内容审核流程处理，不再单独提交企业身份核验，不收集法定代表人、经办人、营业执照或经办授权证明。企业保证填写资料真实、合法且有权使用，发布前主动确认当前协议；审核通过后公开，修改审核期间继续展示已发布版本。
三、资料和网址维护
企业保留上传资料的合法权利，授权平台仅为存储、审核、展示、备份及依法履职进行必要处理。正常内容更新不改变展厅网址或二维码。平台正常运营期间，企业合法使用的专属地址保持稳定；必要升级尽可能保留历史跳转。平台采取合理安全与备份措施，故障、维护或不可抗力时及时说明和恢复，不承诺绝对不中断。
四、资源与展示规则
额度按实际存储及上传预占计量，不足时暂停新上传；不会自动扣费或因超额删除已有合法资料。首页最多12家，采用公布的免费审核入池及每日轮换规则，不构成对所有企业同时展示的承诺。
五、违规处置与救济
对违法、侵权、虚假或冒用资料，平台可要求补正、限制发布、下架或停止服务，记录理由并提供工单申诉渠道；紧急制止违法传播及依法报告不以等待申诉为前提。企业可申请导出资料、停止展示或退出，平台核验归属后处理，并说明依法需保留的记录。
六、协议版本及争议
确认记录包含版本、正文摘要、时间及来源端。已发布版本可查询；实质变更公布后，在下次提交资料前主动确认，不追溯伪造同意。企业已有公开版本按适用规则保留。争议先通过服务工单协商，协商不成依法向有管辖权的人民法院处理。本协议不排除法律规定的责任或救济。
body_en:
Provider: Hebei Qiyuan Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. Recipient: the admitting company and its authorized representative who actively accepts this agreement.
1. Free services
Basic admission, standard showrooms, platform URLs, QR codes, ongoing updates and storage within allowance are permanently free, without a basic annual fee. The default is 200 MB; individual allowances appear in the workspace. Paid storage, bidding, custom paid development and payments are unavailable.
2. Company responsibilities
Company, product and media materials follow the existing content review process. There is no separate company identity submission. Legal representative names, agent names, business licences and agent authorization documents are not collected. Companies must provide truthful, lawful materials they are authorized to use, actively accept current agreements and obtain content approval before publication. Previously published versions remain visible during review.
3. Materials and URLs
Companies retain their rights and permit necessary storage, review, display, backups and legal processing. Normal edits do not change showroom URLs or QR codes. Stable addresses are maintained during lawful use and platform operation, with redirects where possible during necessary upgrades. Reasonable security and recovery measures apply; uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed.
4. Resources and rotation
Stored objects and upload reservations count against allowance. Insufficient capacity blocks new uploads without automatic charges or deletion of existing lawful materials. Up to 12 companies rotate daily under published free eligibility rules; simultaneous homepage display for every company is not promised.
5. Moderation and remedies
Unlawful, infringing, false or impersonating materials may require correction or be restricted or unpublished with reasons and a service-request appeal channel. Urgent action and lawful reporting need not await an appeal. Companies may request export, unpublishing or withdrawal; ownership and lawful record-retention obligations are checked.
6. Versions and disputes
Acceptance records retain version, content digest, timestamp and source. Published versions remain available. Material updates require active confirmation before the next submission; consent is never backdated. Seek resolution through service requests, then a court with lawful jurisdiction if needed. Statutory rights and responsibilities are not excluded.

title: 隐私政策
body:
运营方：河北企元数智科技有限公司。适用于中企展馆网站及大陆农机App。
一、基本浏览
浏览企业及产品无需注册。服务器为提供访问、安全防护与排查故障处理访问时间、IP和必要请求信息；不把密码、令牌或完整核验材料写入访问统计。
二、账号及企业资料
注册及登录处理用户名或手机号、密码的安全摘要和必要会话信息；手机号验证处理短信发送及校验记录，用于注册、找回密码和账号安全。账号密码注册不强制绑定手机号。企业资料中的电话、微信等联系方式由企业主动填写并按展示选择公开，账号登录手机号不因此自动公开。
企业、产品及媒体资料由平台按现有内容审核流程处理，不再单独提交企业身份核验，不收集法定代表人、经办人、营业执照或经办授权证明。企业保证填写资料真实、合法且有权使用，发布前主动确认当前协议；审核通过后公开，修改审核期间继续展示已发布版本。
三、上传、权限和本地保存
上传图片、视频或资料仅在相应操作时使用文件选择；拍照时按需申请相机权限，拒绝后可继续浏览并选择其他可用方式。App本地保存登录会话、草稿、收藏、语言和固定服务连接配置，以支持使用、失败重试和离线草稿。主动分享、外部网页、拨号或微信操作由用户触发。App依赖组件包括Flutter、http、shared_preferences、image_picker、file_picker、path_provider、url_launcher、video_player、pdfrx及二维码组件，按上述功能使用；不接入广告或支付SDK。具体系统权限以操作提示为准。
四、可选访问统计
访问统计默认关闭，只有主动开启后才创建随机访问标识、记录页面、检索、资源及联系动作并发送至本平台后端；不读取通讯录、不记录电话或微信内容。搜索词按规则脱敏，但请勿搜索无关敏感信息。可在隐私设置随时撤回，撤回后停止上报并清理待发送队列和统计标识；拒绝不影响基本浏览。
五、投诉与企业权益
工单处理提交内容、选填联系方式和证据，用于受理、核验和反馈；查询凭证相当于私密钥匙，请妥善保管。历史核验附件和投诉附件不作为公开媒体。企业可登录申请查阅、导出、更正、停展、退出或账号注销；核验归属后处理。依法需保留的安全、审核、协议与争议记录另行说明，不因退出立即销毁。
六、存储、安全及接收方
平台按实际配置使用本机或阿里云OSS对象存储，服务器运维、短信渠道及存储服务在提供功能所必需的范围内处理数据。采用鉴权、权限分级、审核、私有附件、备份和日志等措施；不出售资料，不为广告共享资料。仅在提供服务、保障安全及履行法定义务所必要期间保留；不以本政策承诺未经核实的具体保存期限或跨境处理安排，部署前须核实实际资源和规则。
七、未成年人、变更及联系
企业操作应由具备相应授权的成年人进行。发现误收无关未成年人信息，可通过投诉工单请求处理。政策版本和生效时间可查询，实质变更会提示主动确认；请通过“投诉与服务申请”联系运营方并查看反馈。
body_en:
Operator: Hebei Qiyuan Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. Applies to ZQZG and the 大陆农机 app.
1. Basic browsing
No account is needed to view companies or products. Necessary request times, IP addresses and request information support delivery, security and diagnosis. Passwords, tokens and verification documents are excluded from analytics.
2. Accounts and company materials
Registration and sign-in process usernames or mobile numbers, secure password hashes and necessary session information. Mobile verification processes SMS sending and verification records for registration, password recovery and account security. Username registration does not require a linked phone. Companies actively choose the business phone or WeChat details they publish; an account sign-in number is not automatically published.
Company, product and media materials follow the existing content review process. There is no separate company identity submission. Legal representative names, agent names, business licences and agent authorization documents are not collected. Companies must provide truthful, lawful materials they are authorized to use, actively accept current agreements and obtain content approval before publication. Previously published versions remain visible during review.
3. Uploads, permissions and local data
Files are selected only when uploading. Camera permission is requested only for taking pictures; denial does not prevent browsing. The app locally stores sessions, drafts, favourites, language and fixed service connection configuration for use and retries. Sharing, dialing and external links are user-triggered. Components include Flutter, http, shared_preferences, image_picker, file_picker, path_provider, url_launcher, video_player, pdfrx and QR components for these functions. No advertising or payment SDK is included.
4. Optional analytics
Analytics is off by default. Only an explicit opt-in creates random visitor identifiers and sends page, search, resource and contact-action events to this platform. Address books and phone or WeChat conversations are not read. Search terms are filtered; avoid unrelated sensitive queries. Withdraw in privacy settings to stop reporting and clear queued events and analytics identifiers. Basic browsing remains available.
5. Requests and rights
Requests process submitted text, optional contacts and evidence for investigation and replies. Protect the private lookup credential. Evidence is not public media. Logged-in companies may request access, export, correction, unpublishing, withdrawal or account closure, subject to ownership checks. Legally necessary security, review, agreement and dispute records may be retained with explanation.
6. Storage and recipients
Configured local or Alibaba Cloud OSS storage, server operations and optional SMS providers process only what their function needs. Access controls, private evidence, backups and audit records protect materials. No sale or advertising sharing. Retention is limited to necessary service, security and legal purposes. Actual resources, retention rules and any cross-border arrangements must be verified before deployment.
7. Minors, changes and contact
Company operations should be performed by authorized adults. Report accidentally collected unrelated minor information through a request. Version history and effective dates are available; material changes prompt active confirmation. Contact the operator through Complaints and service requests and use the lookup credential to read replies.
